newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Party City accumulate.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Party City accumulate.

text.p: Jefferies & Co Inc said it has started coverage of Party City Corp, a retailer of party supplies, at accumulate with a long term price target of 20.
-- In a statement, said the company is expected to open 47 new company owned stores and franchise another 20 stores to end 1997 with a total of 267 stores.
-- says fragmented market is ripe for consolidation and believes the company is acquisition minded.
-- says stock is attractive at 16.9 times 1997 estimate of $0.80/shr.
-- shares were up one at 14-3/8 by mid-morning.
